text:
maria: Heads-up — Sirocco's LoRA merge landed on staging about an hour ago. Quick-eval shows a regression in invoice amount extraction after int4 quant. @ethan can you take a look? Artifacts: https://ci.internal/reports/sirocco/1719123456 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deployed commit abc123 -> staging (sirocco/lora-merge) by maria. CI 88% green, 2 warnings.

ethan: On it. Which quant config did we use for the quickpack — int4 w/ nf4 or int4 w/ bitsandbytes? Any failing examples?

maria: int4 w/ bitsandbytes (nf4 fallback off). Fail example pasted from eval: "Invoice total: $1,200.00" -> model extracts "$12". Eval pack link: s3://redwood-evals/sirocco/2024-04-12/quickpack.zip. Aggregate: invoice-amount F1 dropped from 0.92 -> 0.86 (sample size 1.2k). Logs: https://logs.internal/sirocco/1719123456

kai: I saw a similar bump on prod-shadow traffic (same batch config change). Also noticed median latency up ~30ms when prefix caching hits are high. Could be tokenization alignment between LoRA adapter and base tokenizer. Adding a few failing inputs to the thread.

sophia: Running local quickbench now to reproduce. Snippet I used: ```python
from evals import run_quick
run_quick(model='redwood/sirocco:merged-int4', inputs='sirocco/invoice-sample.json', batch_size=8, kv_cache=True)
```

ethan: Hypothesis: quantized KV cache + LoRA scaling causes underflow on amount tokens. Two quick tries: 1) override lora_alpha=32 (increase scale) 2) disable kv-cache for < 32 token contexts. I'll push a debug branch and run subset.

maria: :thumbsup: if that narrows it we can produce a canary and notify Sirocco account team. Also prepare fallback plan.

ethan: Pushed branch: git://git.internal/redwood/lora-quant-fix@def456. Quick run on 200 cases: invoice F1 moved 0.86 -> 0.90 (still -0.02 vs baseline). Full run queued. Diff notes in PR.

sophia: Full eval (1.2k cases) queued on r5a-xlarge, ETA ~35m. Early metrics: hallucination rate (wrong amounts) reduced 3.1% -> 1.0% on the first 200. Saving per-example traces to s3://redwood-evals/sirocco/1719123456/traces.jsonl

kai: If full eval is green, can we add a route-level fallback policy: route="invoice-extract" -> prefer int8 or dedicated instance for Sirocco? That avoids org-wide rollback. @maria will Sirocco accept a soft rollback to int8 for that route?

maria: Yes, Sirocco asked for minimal disruption. We'll propose a soft rollback for invoice route + postmortem explaining root cause. Please include per-token cost delta in the report (int8 -> int4 savings vs quality delta).

ethan: Agreed. Full eval finished: final F1 = 0.91, hallucination down to 0.9% (baseline 0.92/0.3%). Still slightly below baseline on some edge numeric formats. I'm drafting a mitigation: 1) lora_alpha tweak + kv-cache disable for < 40 tokens 2) route fallback to int8 for invoice-extract until we ship a bias-correction quantizer.

sophia: I'll upload the final eval summary and the eval-pack (jsonl + diff) to the ticket: https://tickets.internal/ML-2319. Quick numbers included (CSV attached).

maria: Thanks all. Next steps: ethan produce a canary rollout plan for dedicated for Sirocco, sophia attach artifacts, kai prepare routing policy. I'll loop in AE after we have the final canary numbers.

(End of thread)
